game_leakage_audit.policy: Distinct full-game seeds and provenance; only sampled test positions are symmetry-audited. Opening prefixes can coincide and never become training evidence.

leakage_audit.interpretation: Factorial-only premise model is the independent transfer arm. Frozen C4 prior may already know test contexts; its overlap is explicitly listed and is not evidence of new transfer.

oracle_scope: Fixture generation, auxiliary supervision and evaluation only.
supervision_caution: Repeated synthetic observations share their family dependence group and contribute at most once per hypothesis. Sample efficiency counts distinct contexts separately from repeated observations.
